title: Philosophy of Physics
content: The philosophy of physics scrutinizes the conceptual foundations, ontological commitments, and epistemological boundaries of physical theories. Exploring the debate between scientific realism and empiricism, the absolute versus relational nature of space and time, and the measurement problem of quantum mechanics, this roadmap investigates what physical models reveal about the nature of reality.
